authority: diagnostic: paper only, not investment advice
flags: An ICC arbitration tribunal issued a partial final award finding that Calcasieu Pass breached its obligation to declare COD in a timely manner under the Galp SPA. Damages are still to be set, and the final award will be subject to a $170 million seller aggregate liability cap.
Phase 1 of the Plaquemines Project declared COD and began selling LNG under its post-COD SPAs.
VGLNG entered into power and grid frame agreements for up to 16 power islands and related equipment. If all orders proceed, the aggregate amount payable would be approximately $17.2 billion.

news.headline: Venture Global will pay $35 million to cover Belle Chasse Bridge tolls in Plaquemines Parish, governor says
news.quote: Venture Global commits $35 million toward Belle Chasse Bridge tolls

touches.claim: Debt is large and spending is funded externally. Long-term debt is 42,918 (table in millions) and current debt is 1,694 (table in millions). Nine-month capital expenditures of 10,742 (table in millions) exceeded operating cash flow of 4,743 (table in millions), so refinancing and credit-market access matter.

Driver: higher LNG volumes as the Plaquemines Project ramps up. Volumes sold in the third quarter were 465.8 TBtu against 373.0 TBtu a year earlier, and revenue was 4,756 against 3,329 (table in millions). For this to continue, commissioning and production at Plaquemines must keep advancing and the cargos must keep finding buyers.

Driver and condition: the expansion pipeline of Plaquemines Expansion at 31.0 mtpa and CP2 Expansion at 11.7 mtpa depends on regulatory approvals and commercial support. The applications are pending, and only 1.0 mtpa of long-term contracts has been added for CP2 Expansion so far.

news.why: A five-year $35 million commitment toward Belle Chasse Bridge tolls in Plaquemines Parish is a minor cash outlay that supports local goodwill around Venture Global's Plaquemines operations and expansion.

no_value_reason: share count does not reconcile with filed EPS

business_model.basis: stated in the 10-K Item 1 business description
business_model.claim: Venture Global sells U.S. LNG produced at its Louisiana export facilities. The filings describe it as vertically integrated across liquefaction, gas transportation, shipping and regasification.
quotes: Venture Global is a long-term, low-cost provider of U.S. LNG sourced from resource rich North American natural gas basins.

business_model.basis: stated in the 10-K Item 1 commercial strategy
business_model.claim: LNG is sold FOB, DPU or DES, either directly from the projects or through the sales and shipping business (VG Commodities). Revenue comes from three channels: commissioning sales before COD, contracted SPAs, and excess capacity sales.
quotes: LNG produced by our facilities is sold to our customers on either a FOB, DPU or DES basis, directly from our projects or through our sales and shipping business.

business_model.claim: Contracted SPAs are mostly long-term, fixed-price agreements. About 96% of contracted volumes are on 20-year terms, and the total executed was 47.0 mtpa at year-end 2025. Customers pay a take-or-pay liquefaction fee plus a variable commodity fee, and these contracts have historically underpinned project financing.
quotes: Approximately 96% of contracted volumes are under 20-year, fixed price sales and purchase agreements that provide stable, long-term cash flows.

business_model.basis: stated in 10-K Items 1 and 7; the margin-pass-through reading is inferred
business_model.claim: Contract pricing has a fixed liquefaction fee, a variable commodity fee of at least 115% of Henry Hub, and a transportation charge if sold DPU. The commodity fee is meant to cover feed gas cost, so natural gas price moves largely pass through.
quotes: a variable commodity fee equal to at least 115% of Henry Hub per MMBtu of LNG
which is intended to cover the price of the feed gas and gas transportation costs

business_model.claim: Sales above nameplate capacity are a distinct revenue source and are meant to be sold on spot, short, medium or long terms. Facilities are designed to produce up to 40% above guaranteed nameplate capacity, but the company says it cannot assure it will produce or resell that excess.
quotes: Our facilities are designed to produce LNG in excess of their guaranteed nameplate capacity

business_model.basis: stated for sales and shipping; project-level reporting is inferred from the project tables
business_model.claim: The 10-K identifies sales and shipping as a reportable segment from 2025, previously combined in corporate, other and eliminations. The 10-K also reports project-level tables for Calcasieu and Plaquemines, and the CP2 Project is under construction. The evidence does not list every reportable segment.
quotes: During the year ended December 31, 2025, the Company's sales and shipping business met the criteria to be a reportable segment.

business_model.basis: stated in the 10-Q income statement and MD&A
business_model.claim: Revenue is growing mainly because of volume from the Plaquemines Project as it ramps up and commissions. Q3 revenue was 4,756 against 3,329 a year earlier. Nine-month revenue was 13,933 against 9,324 (all table figures in millions). LNG volumes sold in Q3 were 465.8 TBtu against 373.0.
quotes: higher LNG sales volumes primarily from the Plaquemines Project due to commissioning and the continued ramp up of LNG production

business_model.claim: Price also moves revenue. The weighted average price of LNG sold in Q3 was $10.16 per MMBtu against $8.92, with the liquefaction fee component rising to $6.76 from $5.38 and the commodity fee falling to 3.40 from 3.54. For the nine months the average price was lower at $9.81 against $10.09.
quotes: higher liquefaction fees primarily from LNG produced by our Plaquemines Project

business_model.basis: stated in 10-K Item 7 and the 10-Q; the pass-through link is inferred
business_model.claim: The largest cost is cost of sales, mainly feed gas. It was 1,744 in Q3 against 1,388, and 6,188 for nine months against 3,866 (table in millions). The Q3 rise came mostly from higher volumes, plus a fair value change on natural gas supply contracts.
quotes: The direct costs of purchasing, transporting and converting natural gas to LNG are the primary component of our cost of sales.

business_model.claim: Other operating costs are growing as plants ramp up. Q3 operating and maintenance expense was 303 against 245, depreciation and amortization was 268 against 218, and development expense fell to 33 from 53 as projects reached probable status and costs were capitalized (table in millions).
quotes: This decrease was primarily due to the phases of the CP2 Project and certain of our pipeline projects being declared probable throughout 2025 and 2026, resulting in the majority of the costs incurred to develop the projects subsequently being capitalized.

business_model.basis: stated in the cash flow statement, balance sheet and MD&A; the funding reading is inferred
business_model.claim: The business is capital- and debt-heavy. Nine-month capital expenditures were 10,742 against operating cash flow of 4,743, funded largely by debt issuance of 15,421. Long-term debt was 42,918 at September 30, 2026. Q3 net interest expense was 486 against 421 (table in millions).
quotes: This increase was primarily from higher non-capitalizable interest costs due to placing additional Plaquemines Project assets in service in accordance with the applicable accounting guidance, higher commitment fees, and an increase in our average outstanding debt.

business_model.basis: stated in the 10-Q and 10-K; the revenue-mix shift is inferred
business_model.claim: Plaquemines Phase 1 reached COD on October 31, 2026, so its LNG moves from commissioning sales to post-COD SPAs with phase one customers. Commissioning cargo sales must stop at COD, and the 10-K says they may be more valuable than post-COD revenue, depending on market conditions.
quotes: We are obligated to cease sales of commissioning cargos once the relevant COD occurs.

business_model.claim: Customer concentration is high. In 2025, about 50.0% of revenue from individual external customers came from three customers, and one customer was about 23% of revenue.
quotes: For the year ended December 31, 2025, approximately 50.0% of our revenue for the period from individual external customers was concentrated across three customers.

business_model.basis: stated in the Q3 2026 earnings release
business_model.claim: Management's 2026 Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA guidance is $10.0 billion to $10.3 billion. It assumes a liquefaction fee of $21.00/MMBtu to $22.00/MMBtu on remaining unsold cargos, so uncontracted-volume pricing is a key earnings driver. Contracted 2026 cargos were 99% of available at a $6.46/MMBtu weighted average fee.
quotes: We assume a fixed liquefaction fee range of $21.00/MMBtu - $22.00/MMBtu for our remaining unsold cargos in 2026 in support of our guidance

business_model.basis: stated in the income statement and MD&A; the comparison with operating income is inferred
business_model.claim: Reported net income is affected by non-operating swap results. Q3 income from operations was 2,295, but net income attributable to common stockholders was 2,546. A gain on interest rate swaps of 1,368 offset net interest expense of 486 (table in millions).
quotes: This favorable change was primarily due to an increase in the forward interest rate curves during the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared to a decrease during the three months ended September 30, 2025.

business_model.basis: stated in the 10-Q risk factors, earnings release and 8-K
business_model.claim: The company is also pursuing a possible new line of business, an off-grid AI utility for data centers built on its island-mode power network. The evidence shows frame agreements and risk factors but no revenue from this activity.
quotes: We are pursuing opportunities to develop our own AI Utility, at sites we own or control.

business_model.claim: Legal and contractual disputes can affect sales terms. A tribunal found that the Calcasieu project company breached its obligation to declare COD on time under the Galp SPA, with a final award subject to a $170 million seller aggregate liability cap. The company says the award does not change the SPA terms as presently performed.
quotes: the final award will be subject to the $170 million seller aggregate liability cap in the SPA

competitive_position.basis: stated in the 10-K business section; self-description by management
competitive_position.claim: The company describes itself as a low-cost, vertically integrated U.S. LNG producer. Its modular 'design-one, build-many' approach is meant to bring capacity online faster than traditional LNG projects. This is management's own positioning, not independently verified.
quotes: Venture Global is a long-term, low-cost provider of U.S. LNG sourced from resource rich North American natural gas basins.

competitive_position.basis: stated in the 10-Q MD&A and income statement
competitive_position.claim: Revenue grew strongly. Third-quarter revenue was $4.8 billion, up 43% from $3.3 billion a year earlier, mainly on higher Plaquemines volumes and higher net sales prices.
quotes: Revenue was $4.8 billion for the three months ended September 30, 2026, a $1.4 billion, or 43%, increase from $3.3 billion for the three months ended September 30, 2025.

competitive_position.basis: stated in the earnings release and 10-Q; the contrast with operating expense growth is inferred from the income statement
competitive_position.claim: Operating profit rose faster than revenue. Third-quarter income from operations was $2.3 billion, up 74%, helped by Plaquemines volumes and higher prices net of feed-gas cost.
quotes: Income from operations of $2.3 billion, an increase of 74% from Q3 2025

competitive_position.basis: stated in the 10-K and 10-Q; the 47.0 mtpa and 96% figures are as of year-end 2025
competitive_position.claim: Long-term contracts give the company a contracted base. It had executed 47.0 mtpa of SPAs, about 96% of contracted volumes are 20-year fixed-price take-or-pay agreements, and contracted post-COD capacity at CP2 rose from 26.0 to 29.0 mtpa during 2026.
quotes: As of December 31, 2025, we have executed 47.0 mtpa of SPAs with a well-recognized group of third-party customers.

In 2026, the CP2 Project entered into or increased contracted capacity under three 20-year post-COD SPAs for the delivery of a combined 3.0 mtpa from Phase 2, increasing total post-COD capacity contracted from 26.0 mtpa to 29.0 mtpa.

competitive_position.claim: Contract pricing is built to protect margin. A fixed liquefaction fee, partly inflation-adjusted, is paired with a commodity fee of at least 115% of Henry Hub.
quotes: The LNG sales price structure under our Contracted SPAs generally includes (i) a fixed liquefaction fee, a portion of which is subject to an annual adjustment for inflation; (ii) a variable commodity fee equal to at least 115% of Henry Hub per MMBtu of LNG; and (iii) a transportation charge, if sold on a DPU basis.

competitive_position.claim: Moving to post-COD contracts lowered realised fees at the first plant. Calcasieu's weighted average fixed liquefaction fee was $3.63 per MMBtu in the latest year versus $7.15 the year before. The company ties lower prices to the start of sales under its post-COD SPAs.
quotes: This was partially offset by lower weighted average LNG sales prices at our Calcasieu Project due to the commencement of LNG sales under its post-COD SPAs and the higher cost of feed gas.

competitive_position.basis: stated in the earnings release; the dependence on spot pricing is inferred from the stated assumption
competitive_position.claim: Near-term earnings depend on spot-linked pricing. The company raised its full-year Adjusted EBITDA guidance, with 99% of available cargos contracted at a weighted average fee of $6.46. The guidance assumes $21.00 to $22.00 per MMBtu for the remaining unsold cargos.
quotes: Increased contracted 2026 cargos to 99% of available cargos at a weighted average liquefaction fee of $6.46/MMBtu.

We assume a fixed liquefaction fee range of $21.00/MMBtu - $22.00/MMBtu for our remaining unsold cargos in 2026 in support of our guidance, reflecting market forward prices and recently executed cargo sales.

competitive_position.claim: Customer concentration is a named threat. About half of 2025 revenue came from three customers, and one customer was about 23%.
quotes: For the year ended December 31, 2025, approximately 50.0% of our revenue for the period from individual external customers was concentrated across three customers.
Moreover, for the year ended December 31, 2025, we had one customer which represented approximately 23% of our revenue for that same period.

competitive_position.claim: A customer dispute at Calcasieu went against the company. An arbitration tribunal, by majority, found it breached its obligation to declare COD on time under the Galp SPA. Damages are still to be determined and are subject to a $170 million liability cap.
quotes: The award issued by the arbitration tribunal, acting primarily as a majority, found that VGCP had breached its obligation to declare COD of the Calcasieu Project in a timely manner pursuant to the SPA.
Based on the terms of the award issued by the arbitration tribunal, the final award will be subject to the $170 million seller aggregate liability cap in the SPA.

competitive_position.basis: stated in the 10-K table; the 10-Q update is stated in the MD&A
competitive_position.claim: Growth depends on permits and approvals. The 10-K table shows expected capacity across all projects well above what is currently permitted, and several applications to raise authorised capacity were still pending in the latest 10-Q.

competitive_position.basis: stated in the balance sheet and cash flow statement; the funding-gap reading is inferred from those lines
competitive_position.claim: The business is very capital-intensive and debt-funded. Nine-month capital expenditures far exceeded operating cash flow, and long-term debt was a large share of the balance sheet. The gap was met by new borrowing.
quotes: Capital expenditures | (10,742) | (9,740)

competitive_position.claim: Vertical integration into shipping and regasification is part of the differentiation. The owned tanker fleet reached eight in September, and regasification capacity is secured in the United Kingdom and Greece. Monetising spare tanker capacity depends on demand.
quotes: In September 2026, we took delivery of an LNG tanker, Venture Manatee, bringing our total owned fleet of LNG tankers to eight.

We have secured LNG regasification capacity in the United Kingdom and Greece, which is expected to allow us to supply LNG and regasified natural gas directly into the European market to current and additional downstream customers.

competitive_position.basis: stated in the 8-K, earnings release and 10-Q risk factor
competitive_position.claim: The company is exploring an off-grid AI utility and data-center power business, using its island-mode power capability. Frame agreements cover up to 16 power islands, and the aggregate payable if all purchase orders are placed would be about $17.2 billion. It is not binding beyond reservation fees and reserved capacity.
quotes: If we elect to proceed with all purchase orders under the Power Frame Agreement and the Grid Frame Agreement described below, the aggregate amount payable under both agreements, including applicable reservation fees, would be approximately $17.2 billion, subject to adjustment based on various specified criteria.
we have limited experience developing or operating data centers

financial_health.claim: Cash and cash equivalents were 3,420 (table in millions) at the latest quarter end, up from 2,355 (table in millions) at the prior year end. Restricted cash was held in addition: 172 current and 1,535 noncurrent (table in millions).
quotes: Cash and cash equivalents | $ 3,420 | $ 2,355

quotes: Total current assets | 5,223 | 4,040
Total current liabilities | 5,777 | 4,344

financial_health.basis: stated in the balance sheet; the construction-funding link is inferred from the cash flow statement

quotes: Long-term debt, net | 42,918 | 33,393
Current portion of debt, net | 1,694 | 812

financial_health.basis: stated in the income statement and MD&A

Management attributes the quarterly rise mainly to non-capitalizable interest on assets placed in service and a larger average debt balance.

financial_health.basis: stated in the cash flow statement; the funding link is inferred from the line items
financial_health.claim: Operating cash flow was 4,743 (table in millions) for the nine months, against 4,455 a year earlier. Capital expenditures were 10,742, against 9,740, so investment outflows were funded mainly from financing: net cash from financing was 7,451, with debt issuance and draws of 15,421 and repayments of 5,134. Cash, cash equivalents and restricted cash rose by 1,702.
quotes: Net cash from operating activities | 4,743 | 4,455

financial_health.basis: stated in the statements; the quality judgment is inferred from reconciling items

Net income of 4,670 includes a gain on interest rate swaps of 1,507, which the cash flow statement removes through a (1,511) derivative gain adjustment. Cash from settlement of derivatives was 29 against 994 a year earlier. A deferred tax addback of 925 is also non-cash.
quotes: (Gain) loss on derivatives, net | (1,511) | 539
Deferred taxes | 925 | 350

financial_health.basis: stated in the income statement and MD&A

financial_health.basis: stated in the cited items; the direction of the shift is inferred
financial_health.claim: Cash generation is shifting as Plaquemines moves from commissioning sales toward post-COD contracts. Phase 1 declared COD on October 31, 2026. Commissioning-cargo proceeds had been used to prepay $1.9 billion under the CP2 Holdings EBL Facilities. The 10-K risk factors call profitability and positive operating cash flows uncertain.
quotes: On October 31, 2026, the first phase of the Plaquemines Project, our second LNG export facility, declared COD and commenced the sale of LNG under its post-COD SPAs with its phase one customers.
Our ability to maintain profitability and positive operating cash flows is subject to significant uncertainty.

financial_health.claim: A construction term loan that was due in August 2026 was repaid from the proceeds of newly issued notes, so that maturity was refinanced rather than paid from operating cash.
quotes: repaying the outstanding balance of the Calcasieu Pass Construction Term Loan, which was due in August 2026, with proceeds from the newly issued VGCP 2036 Notes;

financial_health.basis: stated in MD&A and the cash flow statement

It redeemed VGLNG notes that carried 8.125% with new notes carrying 6.375% and 6.625%, and redeemed preferred units that carried 10.000% using a new variable-rate term loan. The cash flow statement shows a 1,743 redemption of the preferred units, and redeemable stock of subsidiary fell from 1,696 to nil.
quotes: redeeming the VGLNG 2028 Notes, which carried a stated interest rate of 8.125%

financial_health.basis: stated in the 8-K; the repayment implication is inferred from the maturity date
financial_health.claim: A senior secured 364-day revolving credit facility of $3.0 billion gives general-corporate-purpose liquidity but matures on September 1, 2027. It prices at SOFR plus a 2.50% margin.
quotes: The Credit Agreement and all borrowings thereunder will mature on September 1, 2027.
The applicable margin rate (i) for SOFR-based loans is 2.50% per annum

financial_health.basis: stated in MD&A and the earnings release
financial_health.claim: CP2 construction funding is being arranged in stages. Phase 2 reached FID and obtained $8.6 billion of additional project financing. Management has repaid $2.8 billion of the $3.0 billion Equity Bridge Loan that supported CP2 construction.
quotes: In March 2026, Phase 2 of the CP2 Project achieved FID and we obtained $8.6 billion of additional project financing to fund its development and construction.
Since the start of 2026, repaid $2.8 billion of the $3.0 billion Equity Bridge Loan supporting the CP2 Project construction.

financial_health.claim: Debt classified as current was 1,694 (table in millions), up from 812 at the prior year end. This is the only maturity measure in the evidence; the schedule of later maturities is not provided.

quotes: the final award will be subject to the $170 million seller aggregate liability cap in the SPA
